line_role_contract.rule: Attack priority is selected by the unit's current runtime battlefield line.
line_role_contract.title: Art of Warfare attack priorities

exhausted_long_range_first_fallback.rule: A Second-line Long-Range wave with zero primary ammunition fills open First slots and uses its secondary close weapon. Whole-wave moves are supported with persistent damage; partial splits are executable when persistent damage is zero.

firing_order_contract.rule: Same formations on both sides shoot simultaneously; formation phases execute in the listed shot sequence.
firing_order_contract.title: Art of Warfare shot sequence

target_transfer_contract.rule: Later individual shots select the next listed formation after a higher-priority formation is eliminated.

attacking_matrix_contract.rule: Different unit types occupying one runtime formation contribute source columns to one row-major Attacking Matrix while retaining wave-local weapons, upgrades, and ammunition.
attacking_matrix_contract.title: Ikariam Battle System attacking-matrix construction

target_eligibility_contract.rule: A candidate target is attackable only when the selected weapon's effective ATK is strictly greater than the target's effective DEF. ATK <= DEF is skipped without a shot or ammunition expenditure, and selection continues to the next eligible target.

wall_targeting_contract.rule: When an active Town Wall is present, land Artillery targets Wall before ordinary First-line units; if the wall is fully breached, remaining Artillery fire continues to ordinary First priority.
wall_targeting_contract.experimental_section_allocation: Concentrate penetrating Artillery shots on the lowest surviving wall damage-position until breach, then advance.
wall_targeting_contract.non_penetrating_action: Do not spend the firing ticket on the wall; continue ordinary priority.
